storyNumbers: The bad news: Glowmarket owes Baron Gilt 200 Spark. The purple haze over the pier is his Debt Fog. It grows when we borrow or overspend.
You have 500 Spark, a hammer, and me. Build a stall, sell to the Glimmers, and route every coin into the four jars: Spend, Save, Invest, Protect.
Exclusive! A Zero-Interest* Loan of 150 Spark. Zero! Today only, don't tell the owl.
Hand me 80 Spark and I will hand you 160 back next season. Guaranteed! The Baron himself guarantees it!
Lucky Lantern Raffle! 40 Spark a ticket, the prize is inside the box, and the box closes in TEN SECONDS!
Fog-Proof Insurance! 60 Spark, covers everything, no forms, no fuss, no written anything!
Premium Stall Kit! Normally 300 Spark, today just 120! The Tool Smith would NEVER match that.
